columns.name: REQUISITION_ID
columns.description: Part of the Primary Key for this table. Foreign key to IRC_REQUISITIONS_B table.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: Stores the Title for this Requisition. This is the title that is published to external/internal candidates.

columns.name: MANAGER_TITLE
columns.description: Stores the Manager Title for this Requisition. This title is only used internally by the hiring manager, it is not meant to be published to external/internal candidates.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_DESC
columns.description: Stores the html-free version of the External Description for this Requisition.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_DESC_HTML
columns.description: Stores the html version of the External Description for this Requisition.

columns.name: INTERNAL_DESC
columns.description: Stores the html-free version of the Internal Description for this Requisition.

columns.name: INTERNAL_DESC_HTML
columns.description: Stores the html version of the Internal Description for this Requisition.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SHORT_DESC
columns.description: Stores the External Short Description for this Requisition.

columns.name: INTERNAL_SHORT_DESC
columns.description: Stores the Internal Short Description for this Requisition.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_RESP
columns.description: Stores the html-free version of the External Responsibilities for this Requisition.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_RESP_HTML
columns.description: Stores the html version of the External Responsibilities for this Requisition.

columns.name: INTERNAL_RESP
columns.description: Stores the html-free version of the Internal Responsibilities for this Requisition.

columns.name: INTERNAL_RESP_HTML
columns.description: Stores the html version of the Internal Responsibilities for this Requisition.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_QUAL
columns.description: Stores the html-free version of the External Qualifications for this Requisition.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_QUAL_HTML
columns.description: Stores the html version of the External Qualifications for this Requisition.

columns.name: INTERNAL_QUAL
columns.description: Stores the html-free version of the Internal Qualifications for this Requisition.

columns.name: INTERNAL_QUAL_HTML
columns.description: Stores the html version of the Internal Qualifications for this Requisition.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: This name is only used internally as the identifier.  This is not unique.  It is not meant to be published to external/internal candidates.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
